name: @cocreate/workflows
description: Declarative client actions and tenant-scoped server execution for CoCreate workflows.

interface.summary: Loads and executes organization-scoped workflow records using CoCreate AST.

attributes.name: workflow
attributes.role: Declares workflow names on a form scope and initializes workflow methods on the form and descendant input-AST elements.

attributes.name: {name}-key
attributes.role: Maps element values into the workflow request envelope using the named prefix. If keyed values were collected, the same-key workflow result is passed to setData.

actions.name: {workflowName}
actions.description: Runs the named workflow for its nearest declaring container.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Registers workflow Actions and initializes the workflow method on existing or supplied workflow scopes and descendant input AST elements.

methods.name: element.workflow
methods.description: Available on initialized workflow elements and callable from AST as $workflow(name, value). Sends the value under the workflow name and evaluates AST expression strings returned under that same key.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Binds server services and returns the workflow handler for registration on the workflow socket event.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Resolves a workflow by method name, executes ordered actions with $data referencing the original envelope, and appends errors to envelope.error.

author: CoCreate LLC
